deities: Goddess Chandrika Devi (form of Goddess Durga)

history.period: Legendary origins; present temple ~250 years old (by tradition)
history.summary: The famous Chandrika Devi temple at Kathwara (Kathvara) village near Bakshi Ka Talab on the Lucknow–Sitapur road, about 28 km from Lucknow city, set beside the Gomti on three sides with the Mahisagar Theertha pond and a Kala Bhairav shrine at the rear. Tradition: Yudhishthira's son Sudhanwa worshipped the goddess here (hence Sudhanwa Kund); a 12th-century shrine was destroyed by the army of Sayyad Salar Masud Gazi; about 250 years ago villagers found the idol in a neem-tree cavity and the village landlord built the present temple with a homa vedi. CSV TOWN FLAG: CSV lists Lucknow; the temple actually stands at Kathwara, Bakshi Ka Talab, Lucknow district — town corrected. Antiquity claims are traditional, not documented — treat with caution.

name: Chandrika Devi Temple
town_description: Kathwara (Kathvara) is a village near Bakshi Ka Talab in Lucknow district on the Lucknow–Sitapur road, about 28 km from Lucknow city — the site of the famous Chandrika Devi Siddhapeeth, with mango orchards and a lakeside setting popular for picnics.

travel.airport: Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport, Lucknow (~45 km)
travel.road: Kathwara, near Bakshi Ka Talab on the Lucknow–Sitapur road, ~28 km from Lucknow; best reached by cab or own car

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; annual mela during Navratri (very crowded — avoid during monsoon)
visitor_information.opening_hours: 5:00 AM–1:00 PM, 4:00–11:00 PM (aarti at 6 AM, 1 PM, 7 PM per Tripadvisor; conflicting listings 2:00–10:00 PM — verify locally)
